definitions.explanation: A person who has an excessive or inappropriate interest in sexual matters. Used as a noun to label someone.
Describes behavior, thoughts, or character that is sexually indecent or overly focused on sexual matters.

notes:
USAGE:
A colloquial, mildly vulgar word. Can be used both as a noun (⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧スケベ) and as a な-adjective (スケベな). The tone ranges from genuinely critical to playfully teasing depending on context. Also written as すけべ or {助平|すけべい} in kanji (rare). Variants include スケベー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スケベな⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (perverted gaze)
- スケベな⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (dirty talk)
- スケベな⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧ (dirty joke)
- スケベ⟦おやじ→おやじ：10249_oyaji⟧ (dirty old man)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- エッチ: perverted, naughty — milder and more playful
- ⟦いやらしい→いやらしい：10233_iyarashii⟧: indecent, suggestive — can be used more broadly for anything unpleasant or sleazy
